notes: The report opens «قال وحدثني»: the «قال» continues the speaker of the previous report, which is not in this context, so only the names written here are read
«سمعت شيخا بأذرعات» : the old man is unnamed and is an unnamed link at his place
Ali is named in the words after the chain («سمعت عليا عليه السلام يقول»), so he is the last link as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); «فقام إليه رجل» is the scene, not a link
